text_en: Seems like word's gotten around that you and the other guy saved the city.
To be honest, I knew Sirfiel's brother was tough enough for this. All he had to do was try.
So, you've worked together with those fish people? I'd never have imagined that beings like that existed, let alone that they'd cooperate with Zarga.
Although I suppose I shouldn't be so surprised. It seems that anything's possible in this city.
